status: plan review required; not implementation approval yet
hypothesis: Repeated-prefix sibling read requests are logically parallel but client serializes them. Combine post(A)+full pre(B) into one physical HTTP batch while retaining all logical checks, original order and isolated execution.
scope: Local generic strict source transport; no Family, Solver search, final sim policy, source authority or live configuration changes
requirements: Eligibility must prove identical immutable source endpoint/hash/root, prefix, caller environment, and effective cancellation/deadline ownership. Noneligible ordinary paths keep single-request behavior.

Do not promote an independently cancellable queued request into shared active work. Batch only siblings whose cancel signal and effective absolute deadline are identical; no IDs/address/selector protocol branches.
No longer deadline, retry owner or queue reordering. Validate and snapshot all request bodies before yield; bound grouping and payload size; late arrivals remain normal queued work.

Wire group keeps independently authenticated request IDs, responses, source attestations, ordinary errors and ordered execution. Duplicate/malformed/out-of-order/unexpected frames fail closed. Fatal precedence and physical child/stdio drain retained.
All three prechecks and canonical postcheck remain for EVERY logical request; only physical HTTP batching changes. No cached source result and no logical check deduplication.
Full original prefix execution per request from fresh request-local state; no EVM journal/transient/gas/warmth sharing. Existing source-value cache may remain.
Combined post(A)+pre(B) validates A before accepting its response and B before any B execution. Source faults remain fatal for whole lease, including cancelled/late responses.
Diagnostics distinguish logical validations and physical requests; no apparent per-request speedup merely from moving time between requests. Measure full sibling group and full hop from common start.
If grouping cannot be implemented without changing cancellation/source invariants, reject this design and report; do not relax safeguards to force eligibility.
